server_url.description: AstrBot-Deploy Web panel URL, for example http://server-ip:7070.

remote_token.description: Remote API token. It must match remote_api_token in /opt/astrbot/panel_config.json.

owner_ids.description: QQ users allowed to request login.

bot_self_ids.description: Bot QQ accounts allowed to respond. Default only allows 2141945863.

allowed_groups.description: Allowed group IDs. Empty means no group limit.

qr_retry_seconds.description: Seconds before the same user can request a fresh QR code again. Default 60 seconds.
